notes.title: Update to fix issue with Cash score carrying forward per playthrough
notes.content: When players where going from round to round the cash score was coming with them and inflating too high. So I put an end to that chicanery.

notes.title: DROP 2 IS NOW LIVE - WIN A PLAYSTATION 5
notes.content:
🛠️ Tooncop – Drop 2 Patch Notes
Version: Drop 2 Launch Build
Date: [Insert today’s date]

🎉 New Content
🔥 DROP 2 IS LIVE!
The second official content drop is now available, featuring a brand new prize pool and expanded gameplay incentives.

🎁 PRIZE DRAW SYSTEM ACTIVATED
Three prize chests have been added to the map:

🟢 Easy Chest – Score goal: LOW → 1 Prize Ticket

🟡 Medium Chest – Score goal: MEDIUM → 5 Prize Tickets

🔴 Hard Chest – Score goal: HIGH → 10 Prize Tickets
Tickets earned count toward the PlayStation 5 prize draw (draw date to be announced soon).

💾 SUBMISSION SYSTEM ENABLED
Players can now record their playthroughs and submit their entries at www.tooncop.com to claim their tickets and secure their place in the prize draw.

✨ New Prizes Available
🕹️ 1x PlayStation 5 Console – Only one up for grabs!

🖼️ Signed music memorabilia – From select underground artists.

🧶 Artisan-crafted physical prizes – Custom goods designed for the Tooncop community.

🛠️ Gameplay & Balance Tweaks
⏱ 15-minute timer now begins once the first enemy is engaged.

⚖️ Enemy wave pacing adjusted to better scale in difficulty over time.

📈 Score values and multipliers rebalanced across all chest tiers.
💀 Pomchi spawn frequency and speed has been slightly reduced... for your sanity. (You're welcome.)

🐞 Bug Fixes
Fixed issue where some players were not receiving score tallies at the end of a match.

Fixed overlapping UI elements during loot chest unlock events.

Fixed an exploit where players could farm tickets by restarting before timeout.

📢 Reminder
This game is still in early development by a solo indie dev. If you encounter bugs, weirdness, or Pomchi-related trauma, please send feedback via the submission form or on social.

💻 Download or update Tooncop now on Steam

🎮 Play. Compete. Win something REAL.

notes.content:

Reduced the XP cost of the Drop 1 chest to 50 from 100
Reduced the amount of VFX and removed explosions from all pill drops
Lowered lighting across the map
Added helicopter search light

Also added some new parts to Neighborhood Dark....

notes.title: UPDATE 1
notes.content:
Hi Guys. 

Just a quick note to say that the map Neighborhood Dark has been updated and is now the official Nightmare Mode of the game. 

I've also added a number of guns to the map, just find the houses with the lights on to find the guns. 

They are mostly SMGs in this update and I'll be adding more guns as time progresses. 

Another update is that we now have Russian localization on the Steam Page for those countries that speak the language. Big thanks to Berry for offering to help with that one. 

More updates are in the pipeline. 

Thank you all, happy shooting.
